blocks.prompt: 11. Find the equations of the circles passing through the points \(A(3, 2)\) and \(B(3, -2)\) and touching the line \(x + 2y + 3 = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
Circle do points se guzarta hai aur ek line ko touch karta hai, lekin is dafa touch hone wala point nahi diya. Yeh Case 4 hai, bilkul Example 8 jaisa.
Diya kya hai? \(A(3, 2)\), \(B(3, -2)\) aur line \(x + 2y + 3 = 0\).
Find kya karna hai? Circles ki equations; quadratic aayegi is liye do circles.
Rule kaunsa? Centre dono points se barabar door, aur centre se line ka perpendicular faasla radius ke barabar.
Plan: \(|CA| = |CB|\) se \(k\), phir faasla = radius se \(h\) ki quadratic.
steps:
Diya gaya: circle \(A(3, 2)\), \(B(3, -2)\) se guzarta hai aur \(x + 2y + 3 = 0\) ko touch karta hai.
Maloom karna: circles ki equations.
Tareeqa: Case 4 (Example 8). Centre \(C(h, k)\) farz karein. Do shartein: \(|CA| = |CB|\) (dono radius hain) aur centre se line ka faasla \(= r\) (touch ki shart).

\(|CA|^2 = |CB|^2\)
\[(h - 3)^2 + (k - 2)^2 = (h - 3)^2 + (k + 2)^2\]
\[-4k + 4 = 4k + 4,\quad k = 0\]
Kyun: Dono points centre se radius jitna door hain. \((h - 3)^2\) dono taraf cancel, \(k^2\) bhi cancel, sirf \(-4k = 4k\) bacha. Matlab centre \(x\)-axis par hai, jo \(AB\) ka perpendicular bisector hai.

Radius
\[r = |CA| = \sqrt{(h - 3)^2 + 4}\]
Kyun: Centre \((h, 0)\) se \(A(3, 2)\) tak distance formula.

Line ko touch karna
\[\dfrac{|h + 2(0) + 3|}{\sqrt{1^2 + 2^2}} = \sqrt{(h - 3)^2 + 4}\]
Kyun: Point se line ka perpendicular faasla \(\frac{|ax_1 + by_1 + c|}{\sqrt{a^2 + b^2}}\). Tangent ka centre se faasla hamesha radius hota hai.

Square kar ke hal karein
\[(h + 3)^2 = 5[(h - 3)^2 + 4]\]
\[h^2 + 6h + 9 = 5h^2 - 30h + 65\]
\[4h^2 - 36h + 56 = 0\]
\[h^2 - 9h + 14 = 0\]
\[(h - 2)(h - 7) = 0\]
Kyun: Dono sides non-negative hain, square karna mehfooz hai. \(5(h^2 - 6h + 13) = 5h^2 - 30h + 65\). Sab ek taraf, 4 se divide, phir factorise: \(2 \times 7 = 14\), \(2 + 7 = 9\).
Dhyan dein: \(\sqrt{5}\) ko square karte waqt left ka denominator 5 ban jata hai; usay right par multiply karna na bhoolein.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{|2 + 3|}{\sqrt{5}} = \sqrt{5},\quad \dfrac{|7 + 3|}{\sqrt{5}} = 2\sqrt{5} = \sqrt{20}\]
Kyun: Har centre se line ka faasla us ke radius ke barabar hai. Touch hone wale points \((1, -2)\) aur \((5, -4)\) hain (figure dekhiye).
